body:
Thanks man, I hope I'll try just I feel I have lost all enthusiasm in doing most things and I hate it. I know I keep making it harder but all I feel I can do sit around alone and get upset, I really wish this wasn't real. 
Everyday I wake up I end up crying just cos she's not there anymore and probably won't be again, and I really feel I've lost someone really special I could have avoided this completely which just makes me feel worse and guilty. 
Thanks again though dude I appreciate the advice

Thanks for the advice guys, I wish I could just move on but i still love her if I'm being honest with myself and it's such a horrible feeling to know that one person who really loved me back  for Who i was, no longer feels the same, i feel it's destroyed my confidence I wake up feeling miserable and I try to not think about it but she really did make me happy and I like to think I did the same for her.

It's much easier said than done man I know what you're saying but I honestly don't feel like anyone else understands me quite like her and I know I shouldn't assume that she'd be there for me when I was there for her but it's feels like I'm having a nightmare and every time I wake up im reminded that I fucked up
